Senior Data Scientist

We are hiring a Senior Data Scientist based in Bangalore. The ideal candidate has 4-7 years of experience building machine learning models and data pipelines.

Must-have skills: Python, SQL, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, NLP, PyTorch, TensorFlow, Pandas, NumPy, Spark, Docker, Kubernetes, AWS.

Good-to-have: GCP, Airflow, Databricks.

Required certifications: AWS Certified, TensorFlow Certified.

Responsibilities:
- Build and deploy ML models to production
- Design data pipelines using ETL and Airflow
- Work with cross-functional teams in an agile environment
